posts.author: puneetc
posts.text: I don’t think it’s necessarily a bad thing. IRCTC has been trying to expand its growth by getting larger share of air ticketing but hasn’t made any significant progress. OTOH, Balmer Lawrie has a captive Market for air ticketing for all govt employees. This could bring in synergies and reduce cost on air ticketing business for combined entity. The other legacy business, mostly low margin ones, don’t make much sense for IRCTC though

posts.author: Prashantit2009
posts.text: How do you see the merger talks between Balmer Lawrie and IRCTC. I believe it’s just another distraction for IRCTC and not the best outcome for the retail shareholders. IRCTC should be focusing mostly on the internet ticketing business and how they can get the interest of a lot more advertisers to advertise on their platform.
